services.name: Slim's Stocktoberfest
services.desc: Want to re-live the glory days of paintball? When you had to run, snap and snipe out the competition, not just hide behind a "rope of paint." Come join us for the biggest TRUE stock-class games on the planet, and experience how the game of paintball was meant to be played - with skill, sportsmanship and camaraderie! What is Stock Class? you ask... STOCK-CLASS = GUNS THAT ARE PUMP/MANUALLY OPERATED, WITH A HORIZONTAL FEED, AND POWERED BY A SINGLE 12-GRAM CO2 BYOP! • FLAG CAPTURE • WOODSBALL • STOCK-CLASS ONLY CAMP OUT THE NIGHT BEFORE • HUGE RAFFLE • SWAP MEET • FOOD TRUCK & MORE! $45 The BIGGEST Stock-Class Games on the Planet!!

services.desc: Come join your friends and play in one of the last AG events of the season. This will also be a (B)ring (Y)our (O)wn (P)aint Day! Because it is one of the last big events of the year, entry fees will start at $30! That's right, this means you can bring your leftover paint to our field and shoot it. Play on all of AG's signature features and still get the great service you expect. $30 admission including all day air Need Equipment? No Problem. Add $10 for Equipment rentals. Private Parties are still available for groups of 10+ upon request. Please note that private parties are required BYOP (Bring Your Own Paint!)
